integrity: The witness is derived by exact substitution into the published rapid-gradient formula and line-search rule. The residual along the search line is an explicit quadratic whose coefficients have the same negative sign, proving strict objective increase for every nonzero real step. Exact rational and symbolic checks accompany the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: The counterexample is a scalar rank-one well-definedness obstruction for the rapid-gradient branch. It does not claim generic failure from random high-dimensional initializations, robustness under perturbations, or failure of a version with an immediate true-gradient fallback.
title: Exact line-search deadlock in rapid gradient descent for low-rank recovery
